outcome: Offspring BMI at 1 and 2 years of age
Offspring weight gain at 1 and 2 years of age
Offspring overweight/obesity at 2 years of age
cohort: 261 mother-child pairs where the neonates were born at term with appropriate weight for gestational age between April 2013 and October 2015 in a suburban area of Taiwan, excluding those with major congenital anomalies or diseases, incomplete data, mothers with systemic diseases or drug abuse.
finding: Maternal pre-delivery BMI was significantly associated with offspring BMI and weight gain at the age of 2 years.
